B also proposes a real evidence test: a customer recognition survey. A is tighter and more restrained, but B's refinements stay within the existing mark. B loses a little for its long list of extras, such as the full version set and a whole design system. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers clearly say to keep the identity.
